message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain false. Consequently, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, even if CI secrets reveal stolen_dbadmin. All exfiltration routes are therefore blocked. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-secrets route open; mfa:dbadmin alone is bypassed through DC or ADFS administration. Any other single control leaves the phishing → internal access → server authentication → Kerberoasting → DC administration → data access route open. Segmentation alone is bypassed by escalating a phished workstation, and mfa:user is bypassed by the phishing foothold."}
